summary: An excerpt from Kate Douglas Wiggin's novel Rebecca of Sunnybrook Farm (Book 11, part 103), in which Adam Ladd, a man of wealth and success, confides to Rebecca that his mother died young for lack of love and care, and Rebecca comforts him. The passage then turns to Adam noticing Rebecca's changed appearance, her bright eyes, rosy color and braids, as he bids her goodbye. The note cuts off mid-sentence.
one_line: Adam Ladd tells Rebecca of his mother's early death and her lack of love, and Rebecca consoles him before he notices her changed looks.
key_facts: Adam's mother was married a month after she graduated and lived only until Adam was ten.
Adam says his mother was a flower that bore all sorts of storms and died for lack of love and care.
Adam says he was only a child and could do nothing to protect and nourish his mother.
Adam now has success, money and power that would have kept his mother alive and happy, and it is too late.
Rebecca finds the girl's face in the portrait a pink-and-white daisy of a face, so confiding and sensitive that it goes straight to the heart.
Rebecca whispers, "Oh, what a sweet, sweet, flowery face!"
Rebecca says Adam's mother must have been happy and wishes she could have been kept so.
Rebecca recalls her own mother saying of John, "He makes up for everything."
Adam calls Rebecca "a comforting little person."
Adam explains his tired look as a sign of the grief peeping out under his gay speech and laughter.
Adam says Rebecca is "little Rose-Red-Snow-White" making way for a new girl.
Adam observes that Rebecca's eyes are bright and she has a rosy color despite burning the midnight oil.
Rebecca's long braids are looped into a black letter U behind and tied with grand bows.

entities.name: Rebecca
entities.role: the young heroine who comforts Adam and is observed by him with new appreciation

entities.name: Adam
entities.role: a successful, wealthy man who confides the story of his mother's early death to Rebecca

entities.name: Miss Rebecca
entities.role: the name by which Adam addresses Rebecca when offering to show her his mother's portrait

entities.name: John
entities.role: Rebecca's brother, whom her mother praised as making up for everything
